name: ui-craft
description: Premium UI/UX design for AI coding agents, in two skills on one shared theme. ui-craft: art direction (16 visual directions), colour theory and psychology, craft details, platform conventions (web, desktop, mobile), an accessible palette generator, a screen audit script, client mockups and product scoring. immersive-web: 3D scenes (Three.js, React Three Fiber, WebGL, WebGPU), shaders, scroll storytelling, cinematic motion and the path from Blender to the browser, with speed budgets and reduced-motion and no-WebGL fallbacks.
